mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username}

SELECT
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.user_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id, u.username, u.password, u.salt, u.phone, u.avatar, u.wx_openid, u.qq_openid, u.dept_id, u.create_time ucreate_time, u.update_time uupdate_time, u.del_flag udel_flag, u.lock_flag lock_flag, u.dept_id deptId, u.full_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE ON SYS_USER_ROLE.ROLE_ID = SYS_ROLE.ROLE_ID WHERE u.del_flag = 0 AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_CODE != 'ROLE_ORDINARY'
AND u.username LIKE ('%' || #{query.username} || '%')
AND u.full_name LIKE ('%' || #{query.fullName} || '%')
AND u.phone LIKE ('%' || #{query.phone} || '%')
AND SYS_ROLE.ROLE_NAME LIKE ('%' || #{query.roleName} || '%')
AND u.dept_id = #{query.deptId}
AND u.username != #{admin}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
